author: Inside Edition
description: Some spring breakers who rented a Florida Airbnb say they made a startling discovery under the sheets: a baby Ball Python! Ball Pythons are not venomous, but they can grow to up to six feet in length. The unexpected encounter was caught on camera. The renters were able to apprehend the little reptile. They threw the snake into the backyard, with hopes that it won't attempt to return. Inside Edition's Les Trent has more.
title: Friends Say They Found Snake In Bed At Airbnb Rental

author: Inside Edition
description: A father raced into the ocean to save his little girl who was caught in a rip current. He reached the child and they were both swept away, trapped in the strong current. Suddenly, a hero appeared, reached the father and daughter, and brought them to safety. The father, Chris Greene, a high school principal, and 28-year-old rescuer Lucas Taub, who happened to be a professional college surf coach, spoke with Inside Edition.
title: Hero Surf Coach Rescues Father And Daughter Caught In Rip Current

author: Inside Edition
description: The "King of Hacks" showed Inside Edition some fun hacks you can do with everyday items in your house. Adam Rose, better known as "The Guy in the Blue Cardigan," is a character actor who lives in Hollywood. He started making viral videos during the Covid-19 pandemic. Rose showed Inside Edition's Jim Moret hacks to open a flip top can, getting grapes off stems and a better way to close a box of cereal.
title: 'The Guy in the Blue Cardigan' Shares Household Hacks

author: Inside Edition
description: Actress Denise Richards decided to get a facelift after a long and successful career in Hollywood. Her plastic surgeon is world renowned Dr. Ben Talei of Beverly Hills. He spoke with Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano. The surgery took four and a half hours. Richards revealed her dramatic before and after look. It is estimated more than six million plastic surgeries are performed each year in the United States.
title: Denise Richards Undergoes Plastic Surgery By Dr. Ben Talei

author: Inside Edition
description: A Santa Monica, California jury took just a day to find that Bill Cosby was liable for drugging and sexually assaulting a woman over 50 years ago. The disgraced TV star has been ordered to pay victim Donna Motsinger over $59 million in damages, stemming from the 1972 incident that occurred in northern California. Cosby did not testify in the trial. His attorney said they plan to appeal the verdict. Jim Moret spoke to Motsinger and her attorney.
title: Bill Cosby Loses $59 Million Sex Assault Lawsuit In California

author: Inside Edition
description: Now you see her, now you don't! Joy Behar appeared on "The View" today, until the show went to commercial. When the show returned, the outspoken host was nowhere to be seen. ABC is not responding to speculation she left the set because she didn't want to share the stage with country star and "American Idol" judge Carrie Underwood. Behar has criticized Underwood's decision to perform at Donald Trump's inauguration last year.
title: Why Did Joy Behar Leave 'The View' During Commercial Break?

author: Inside Edition
description: A flight attendant on the Air Canada plane that collided with a ground vehicle is lucky to be alive. The accident at New York's LaGuardia Airport killed the pilot and co-pilot, and injured dozens of people. One flight attendant was ejected from the cabin onto the tarmac on impact. How did she survive? The fact that she was strapped to her seat may be the reason. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian has more.
title: How Air Canada Flight Attendant Survived New York Airport Crash

author: Inside Edition
description: We're seeing new video of the 2023 incident that led to the cancellation of the new season of "The Bachelorette." A portion of police bodycam was just released that shows law enforcement questioning Taylor Frankie Paul and her now ex-boyfriend, Dakota Mortensen. As cops are speaking to them, the would be-Bachelorette gives Mortensen a backhand slap right across the face. The latest season of "The Bachelorette," starring Paul, was set to premiere this past weekend.
title: Bodycam Video Shows 2023 Incident With Bachelorette Taylor Frankie Paul

author: Inside Edition
description: A Maryland man who became a cornhole champion, despite being a quadruple amputee, now faces murder charges. The Charles County Sheriff says Dayton Webber, 27, was arrested in Virginia after allegedly fleeing the scene of the crime. Investigators say two people flagged down a police car to report they were in the back seat of a car when Webber shot a person sitting in the passenger seat and then fled the scene with the victim. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Quadruple Amputee Cornhole Champion Will Face Murder Charge: Authorities
